# Frozen fixture: `gitmoot-v0.9.0.db`

## What it is

A real SQLite database produced by running the actual `v0.9.0` release binary
of `jerryfane/gitmoot` (not a hand-built or reconstructed schema) through a
real `init` -> `repo add` -> `goal import` -> `agent start` -> `job
open`/`close`/`record` cycle. It is committed here, frozen, so
`internal/db/migration_identity_test.go` can prove migration identity/digest
behavior against a genuine historical predecessor database instead of a
schema built by re-reading the current `migrations` slice (Council correction
packet W1-01, R-06: several earlier correction attempts used newly
constructed or incomplete schemas instead of real historical fixtures, which
can mark unapplied work as applied or miss trigger/index/data interactions).

## Provenance

- Source binary: `gitmoot_linux_arm64`, asset of the `v0.9.0` GitHub release
  of `jerryfane/gitmoot`, downloaded unmodified via
  `gh release download v0.9.0 --repo jerryfane/gitmoot --pattern gitmoot_linux_arm64`.
- Generated by running that binary, unmodified, against a throwaway `-home`
  directory (never the operator's default `~/.gitmoot`) — see
  `../../scripts/gen-v090-fixture.sh` for the exact command sequence.
- Non-empty ledger tables, all populated through v0.9.0's own real CLI code
  paths (no hand-inserted SQL):
  - `jobs`: 2 rows (one `implement` job closed `implemented`, one `review` job
    recorded `approved`)
  - `job_events`: 4 rows (job-open + job-close events for each job above)
  - `tasks`: 1 row (imported from a minimal goal file's `### Task 1: ...`
    section)
  - plus `goals` (1), `agents` (1), `repos` (1)
- `schema_migrations` tops out at version 76 — v0.9.0's migration count at the
  time of that release, well behind the current `migrations` slice, so
  opening this fixture with the current code exercises a real multi-migration
  upgrade, not a no-op.
- Frozen with `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` + `VACUUM`, then the `-wal`/
  `-shm` sidecar files were deleted, so only the single `.db` file (a compact
  ~688 KiB) is committed — no journal, no dead pages.

## Regenerating

This is a one-time, implementer-run step, not part of the test suite's
runtime path — the frozen file above is what tests actually read. Only
re-run it if the fixture needs to be replaced:

```
./scripts/gen-v090-fixture.sh
```

Requires `gh` (authenticated) and `go`. `api.github.com` has been observed to
be flaky; the script retries the release download with backoff. Set
`GITMOOT_FIXTURE_ASSET` to override the downloaded asset name for a different
host platform (default `gitmoot_linux_arm64`).

## Using it in tests

Never open this file in place — `Store.Migrate` mutates the database it is
pointed at (it *is* the upgrade path under test). Copy it to a temp file
first, e.g.:

```go
src, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/fixtures/gitmoot-v0.9.0.db")
...
path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "gitmoot.db")
os.WriteFile(path, src, 0o600)
store, err := db.Open(path)
```
